feedback.problem:
If 
$A=[\begin{aligned}b & a & -b \\ -b & a & b \\ -b & 0 & -b\end{aligned}]$
and
$x=[\begin{aligned}-b \\ 0 \\ b\end{aligned}],$
find $Ax.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $Ax=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
feedback.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Ax & =[\begin{aligned}b & a & -b \\ -b & a & b \\ -b & 0 & -b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-b \\ 0 \\ b\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}b\cdot (-b) & + & a\cdot 0 & + & (-b)\cdot b \\ (-b)\cdot (-b) & + & a\cdot 0 & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,b\cdot b \\ (-b)\cdot (-b) & + & 0\cdot 0 & + & (-b)\cdot b\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-{b}^{2} & + & 0 & + & (-{b}^{2}) \\ {b}^{2} & + & 0 & + & {b}^{2} \\ {b}^{2} & + & 0 & + & (-{b}^{2})\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2{b}^{2} \\ 2{b}^{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
